body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News> PLH Products, Inc. has presented its infrared sauna ''XSE4''at CES 2006. It is a 4-person sauna with the specification of 70"x 49"x73.25", 230V-2160W.
It features 2 wide windows, a glass-embedded door, and standard high quality CD player/AM/FM radio that help you to enjoy sauna in pleasant environment.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliyah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
